model.bh_ops.stg_appointments.name: stg_appointments
model.bh_ops.stg_appointments.raw_code:
-- Raw timestamps come in two formats:
--   '2025-01-06 09:30:00'      = clinic-local wall clock, no offset
--   '2025-01-08T15:00:00Z'     = UTC
-- Both are normalized to clinic-local wall-clock time (naive timestamp).

with src as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (partition by appointment_id order by appt_ts) as _rn
    from {{ source('raw', 'appointments') }}
),

dedup as (
    select * from src where _rn = 1
),

joined as (
    select
        d.appointment_id,
        d.patient_id,
        d.provider_id,
        d.clinic_id,
        d.scheduled_ts as scheduled_raw,
        d.appt_ts as appt_raw,
        d.lead_days,
        d.modality,
        d.status,
        d.reminder_arm,
        c.timezone as clinic_tz
    from dedup d
    left join {{ ref('stg_clinics') }} c
        on d.clinic_id = c.clinic_id
)

select
    appointment_id,
    patient_id,
    provider_id,
    clinic_id,
    case
        when scheduled_raw like '%Z'
            then timezone(clinic_tz, timezone('UTC', strptime(scheduled_raw, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')))
        else cast(scheduled_raw as timestamp)
    end as scheduled_ts,
    case
        when appt_raw like '%Z'
            then timezone(clinic_tz, timezone('UTC', strptime(appt_raw, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')))
        else cast(appt_raw as timestamp)
    end as appt_ts,
    (appt_raw like '%Z') as source_was_utc,
    cast(lead_days as integer) as lead_days,
    modality,
    status,
    reminder_arm
from joined

model.bh_ops.kpi_appointments_monthly.name: kpi_appointments_monthly
model.bh_ops.kpi_appointments_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- No-show and late-cancel rate: denominator = resolved appointments (completed + no_show + late_cancel).
select
    strftime(appt_date, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
    count(*) as appointments_scheduled,
    count(*) filter (where is_resolved = 1) as resolved,
    count(*) filter (where status = 'completed') as completed,
    count(*) filter (where status = 'no_show') as no_shows,
    count(*) filter (where status = 'late_cancel') as late_cancels,
    count(*) filter (where status = 'cancelled') as cancelled,
    cast(count(*) filter (where status = 'no_show') as double)
        / nullif(count(*) filter (where is_resolved = 1), 0) as no_show_rate,
    cast(count(*) filter (where status = 'late_cancel') as double)
        / nullif(count(*) filter (where is_resolved = 1), 0) as late_cancel_rate
from {{ ref('fact_appointment') }}
group by 1
order by 1

model.bh_ops.kpi_ar_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- Days in A/R = paid_date - submit_date for PAID claims, grouped by the month the claim was paid.
select
    strftime(paid_date, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
    count(*) as paid_claims,
    avg(days_in_ar) as mean_days_in_ar,
    median(days_in_ar) as median_days_in_ar
from {{ ref('fact_claim') }}
where claim_status = 'paid' and paid_date is not null
group by 1
order by 1

model.bh_ops.fact_appointment.name: fact_appointment
model.bh_ops.fact_appointment.raw_code:
-- Grain: one row per valid appointment.
-- Excluded (quarantined, counted in reports/dq_report.md): unknown patient, unknown provider,
-- or appointment dated before the patient record was created.
select
    a.appointment_id,
    a.patient_id,
    a.provider_id,
    a.clinic_id,
    cast(a.appt_ts as date) as appt_date,
    cast(strftime(a.appt_ts, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as date_key,
    a.scheduled_ts,
    a.appt_ts,
    hour(a.appt_ts) as appt_hour,
    isodow(a.appt_ts) as appt_dow,
    a.lead_days,
    case
        when a.lead_days <= 1 then '0-1'
        when a.lead_days <= 7 then '2-7'
        when a.lead_days <= 14 then '8-14'
        when a.lead_days <= 21 then '15-21'
        when a.lead_days <= 30 then '22-30'
        else '31+'
    end as lead_bucket,
    a.modality,
    a.status,
    a.reminder_arm,
    case when a.status = 'no_show' then 1 else 0 end as is_no_show,
    case when a.status = 'late_cancel' then 1 else 0 end as is_late_cancel,
    case when a.status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end as is_cancelled,
    case when a.status = 'completed' then 1 else 0 end as is_completed,
    case when a.status in ('completed', 'no_show', 'late_cancel') then 1 else 0 end as is_resolved
from {{ ref('stg_appointments') }} a
join {{ ref('stg_patients') }} p
    on a.patient_id = p.patient_id
join {{ ref('stg_providers') }} v
    on a.provider_id = v.provider_id
where cast(a.appt_ts as date) >= p.created_date

model.bh_ops.fact_claim.name: fact_claim
model.bh_ops.fact_claim.raw_code:
-- Grain: one row per claim whose appointment is in fact_appointment.
-- Excluded (quarantined): unknown appointment, or amounts violating paid <= allowed <= billed.
-- is_first_pass_denied = a denial code was recorded on first submission (even if later recovered).
select
    c.claim_id,
    c.appointment_id,
    c.patient_id,
    c.billed_amount,
    c.allowed_amount,
    c.paid_amount,
    c.claim_status,
    c.denial_code,
    c.resubmission_count,
    c.submit_date,
    cast(strftime(c.submit_date, '%Y%m%d') as integer) as submit_date_key,
    c.paid_date,
    case when c.claim_status = 'paid' and c.paid_date is not null
         then date_diff('day', c.submit_date, c.paid_date) end as days_in_ar,
    case when c.denial_code is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_first_pass_denied
from {{ ref('stg_claims') }} c
join {{ ref('fact_appointment') }} a
    on c.appointment_id = a.appointment_id
where c.paid_amount <= c.allowed_amount
  and c.allowed_amount <= c.billed_amount

model.bh_ops.kpi_prior_auth_monthly.name: kpi_prior_auth_monthly
model.bh_ops.kpi_prior_auth_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- By submission month and urgency. Breach and denial rates use DECIDED requests only (pending excluded).
-- SLA thresholds: ASSUMPTION borrowed from CMS-0057-F (72h urgent / 7 calendar days standard).
select
    strftime(submitted_ts, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
    urgency,
    count(*) as requests,
    count(decided_ts) as decided,
    count(*) filter (where is_sla_breach = 1) as sla_breaches,
    cast(count(*) filter (where is_sla_breach = 1) as double) / nullif(count(decided_ts), 0) as sla_breach_rate,
    avg(turnaround_hours) as mean_turnaround_hours,
    median(turnaround_hours) as median_turnaround_hours,
    count(*) filter (where status = 'denied') as denied,
    cast(count(*) filter (where status = 'denied') as double) / nullif(count(decided_ts), 0) as denial_rate
from {{ ref('fact_prior_auth') }}
group by 1, 2
order by 1, 2

model.bh_ops.fact_prior_auth.name: fact_prior_auth
model.bh_ops.fact_prior_auth.raw_code:
-- Grain: one row per prior-auth request with a known patient.
-- SLA thresholds are an ASSUMPTION borrowed from the CMS-0057-F public rule
-- (72h urgent / 7 calendar days standard); not a claim about behavioral-health payers.
-- Pending requests (no decision yet) have NULL turnaround and NULL breach flag.
select
    pa.pa_id,
    pa.patient_id,
    pa.submitted_ts,
    pa.decided_ts,
    pa.urgency,
    pa.status,
    pa.denial_reason,
    case when pa.decided_ts is not null
         then cast(date_diff('second', pa.submitted_ts, pa.decided_ts) as double) / 3600.0 end as turnaround_hours,
    case when pa.urgency = 'urgent' then 72 else 168 end as sla_threshold_hours,
    case
        when pa.decided_ts is null then null
        when cast(date_diff('second', pa.submitted_ts, pa.decided_ts) as double) / 3600.0
             > case when pa.urgency = 'urgent' then 72 else 168 end then 1
        else 0
    end as is_sla_breach
from {{ ref('stg_prior_authorizations') }} pa
join {{ ref('stg_patients') }} p
    on pa.patient_id = p.patient_id

model.bh_ops.kpi_access_monthly.name: kpi_access_monthly
model.bh_ops.kpi_access_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- By intake month. Later cohorts have less follow-up time (right-censoring), so recent months look worse.
select
    intake_month as year_month,
    count(*) as intakes,
    count(first_visit_date) as patients_with_first_visit,
    cast(count(first_visit_date) as double) / count(*) as first_visit_rate,
    avg(days_intake_to_first_visit) as mean_days,
    median(days_intake_to_first_visit) as median_days,
    cast(count(*) filter (where days_intake_to_first_visit <= 14) as double)
        / nullif(count(first_visit_date), 0) as pct_within_14d
from {{ ref('kpi_patient_first_visit') }}
group by intake_month
order by intake_month

model.bh_ops.kpi_leakage_monthly.name: kpi_leakage_monthly
model.bh_ops.kpi_leakage_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- Revenue leakage = allowed amount on claims that are denied (unrecovered) or still unpaid more than 90 days
-- after submission, / total allowed. Only months through leakage_max_month (all claims >= 90 days old as of
-- the data end date 2026-06-30), so every 'pending' claim here is genuinely past 90 days.
select
    strftime(submit_date, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
    count(*) as claims,
    cast(sum(allowed_amount) as double) as allowed_total,
    cast(sum(case when claim_status = 'denied' then allowed_amount else 0 end) as double) as leaked_denied,
    cast(sum(case when claim_status = 'pending' then allowed_amount else 0 end) as double) as leaked_unpaid_90d,
    cast(sum(case when claim_status in ('denied', 'pending') then allowed_amount else 0 end) as double)
        / cast(sum(allowed_amount) as double) as leakage_rate
from {{ ref('fact_claim') }}
where strftime(submit_date, '%Y-%m') <= '{{ var("leakage_max_month") }}'
group by 1
order by 1

model.bh_ops.kpi_claims_monthly.name: kpi_claims_monthly
model.bh_ops.kpi_claims_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- By submission month. Clean claim = no first-pass denial code (independent of payment timing).
-- first_pass_denials counts claims with a denial code on first submission, even if later recovered.
-- final_denials counts claims still denied (not recovered).
select
    strftime(submit_date, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
    count(*) as claims_submitted,
    count(*) filter (where denial_code is null) as clean_claims,
    cast(count(*) filter (where denial_code is null) as double) / count(*) as clean_claim_rate,
    count(*) filter (where denial_code is not null) as first_pass_denials,
    cast(count(*) filter (where denial_code is not null) as double) / count(*) as first_pass_denial_rate,
    count(*) filter (where claim_status = 'denied') as final_denials,
    cast(count(*) filter (where claim_status = 'denied') as double) / count(*) as final_denial_rate,
    cast(sum(billed_amount) as double) as billed_total,
    cast(sum(allowed_amount) as double) as allowed_total,
    cast(sum(paid_amount) as double) as paid_total
from {{ ref('fact_claim') }}
group by 1
order by 1

model.bh_ops.kpi_gate_conversion.name: kpi_gate_conversion
model.bh_ops.kpi_gate_conversion.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- Where do patients drop out? Share who ever get scheduled, split by the eligibility and prior-auth gates.
-- eligibility_gate: 'blocked' = latest check inactive / pending_info.
-- pa_gate: no_pa_needed (no request) / pa_not_denied (approved or pending) / pa_denied.
with elig as (
    select patient_id, eligibility_status
    from (
        select
            patient_id,
            eligibility_status,
            row_number() over (partition by patient_id order by checked_ts desc, eligibility_id desc) as rn
        from {{ ref('stg_eligibility_checks') }}
    ) t
    where rn = 1
),

pa as (
    select patient_id, max(case when status = 'denied' then 1 else 0 end) as pa_denied
    from {{ ref('fact_prior_auth') }}
    group by patient_id
),

sched as (
    select distinct patient_id from {{ ref('fact_appointment') }}
),

base as (
    select
        p.patient_id,
        case when e.eligibility_status in ('inactive', 'pending_info') then 'blocked' else 'clear' end as eligibility_gate,
        case
            when pa.patient_id is null then 'no_pa_needed'
            when pa.pa_denied = 1 then 'pa_denied'
            else 'pa_not_denied'
        end as pa_gate,
        case when s.patient_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as scheduled
    from {{ ref('dim_patient') }} p
    left join elig e on p.patient_id = e.patient_id
    left join pa on p.patient_id = pa.patient_id
    left join sched s on p.patient_id = s.patient_id
)

select
    eligibility_gate,
    pa_gate,
    count(*) as patients,
    count(*) filter (where scheduled = 1) as scheduled_patients,
    cast(count(*) filter (where scheduled = 1) as double) / count(*) as scheduled_rate
from base
group by eligibility_gate, pa_gate
order by eligibility_gate, pa_gate

    p.payer_type,
    p.acuity,
    fv.first_visit_date,
    date_diff('day', cast(p.intake_ts as date), fv.first_visit_date) as days_intake_to_first_visit
from {{ ref('dim_patient') }} p
left join first_visit fv
    on p.patient_id = fv.patient_id

with days as (
    select cast(d as date) as date_day
    from generate_series(date '2025-01-01', date '2026-12-31', interval 1 day) as t(d)

model.bh_ops.kpi_funnel.name: kpi_funnel
model.bh_ops.kpi_funnel.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- Nested patient funnel: each stage is a subset of the one before it.
with pat as (
    select patient_id from {{ ref('dim_patient') }}
),

scheduled as (
    select distinct patient_id from {{ ref('fact_appointment') }}
),

completed as (
    select distinct patient_id from {{ ref('fact_appointment') }} where status = 'completed'
),

claimed as (
    select distinct patient_id from {{ ref('fact_claim') }}
),

paid as (
    select distinct patient_id from {{ ref('fact_claim') }} where claim_status = 'paid'
),

stages as (
    select 1 as stage_order, 'Intake completed' as stage, count(*) as patients from pat
    union all
    select 2, 'Appointment scheduled', count(*) from scheduled
    union all
    select 3, 'First visit completed', count(*) from completed
    union all
    select 4, 'Claim submitted', count(*) from claimed
    union all
    select 5, 'Claim paid', count(*) from paid
)

select
    stage_order,
    stage,
    patients,
    cast(patients as double) / first_value(patients) over (order by stage_order) as pct_of_intake,
    cast(patients as double) / lag(patients) over (order by stage_order) as pct_of_prev_stage
from stages
order by stage_order

model.bh_ops.kpi_denials_by_reason.name: kpi_denials_by_reason
model.bh_ops.kpi_denials_by_reason.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- First-pass denials by payer and denial code. Code labels are short plain-language paraphrases.
-- recovered_claims = first-pass denied claims that ended 'paid' after resubmission.
with c as (
    select f.claim_id, f.claim_status, f.denial_code, f.allowed_amount, p.payer_type
    from {{ ref('fact_claim') }} f
    join {{ ref('dim_patient') }} p
        on f.patient_id = p.patient_id
),

tot as (
    select payer_type, count(*) as payer_claims
    from c
    group by payer_type
),

den as (
    select
        payer_type,
        denial_code,
        count(*) as denied_claims,
        count(*) filter (where claim_status = 'paid') as recovered_claims,
        cast(sum(allowed_amount) as double) as allowed_amount_denied
    from c
    where denial_code is not null
    group by payer_type, denial_code
)

select
    d.payer_type,
    d.denial_code,
    case d.denial_code
        when 'CO-16' then 'Missing info / billing error'
        when 'CO-50' then 'Not medically necessary'
        when 'CO-27' then 'Coverage terminated'
        when 'CO-29' then 'Timely filing expired'
        when 'CO-4' then 'Procedure / modifier mismatch'
        when 'CO-18' then 'Duplicate claim'
        when 'CO-197' then 'Prior authorization absent'
        else 'Other'
    end as denial_reason,
    t.payer_claims,
    d.denied_claims,
    cast(d.denied_claims as double) / t.payer_claims as denial_rate,
    d.recovered_claims,
    d.allowed_amount_denied
from den d
join tot t on d.payer_type = t.payer_type
order by d.payer_type, d.denied_claims desc

model.bh_ops.kpi_fill_rate_monthly.name: kpi_fill_rate_monthly
model.bh_ops.kpi_fill_rate_monthly.raw_code:
{{ config(materialized='view') }}
-- Fill rate = booked slots (appointments not cancelled in advance) / assumed capacity.
-- Capacity = sum of provider weekly slots * capacity_multiplier * days_in_month / 7. ASSUMPTION (see docs).
with cap as (
    select cast(sum(weekly_slot_capacity) as double) * {{ var('capacity_multiplier') }} as weekly_slots
    from {{ ref('dim_provider') }}
),

days as (
    select year_month, count(*) as days_in_month
    from {{ ref('dim_date') }}
    group by year_month
),

booked as (
    select
        strftime(appt_date, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
        count(*) filter (where status <> 'cancelled') as booked_slots
    from {{ ref('fact_appointment') }}
    group by 1
)

select
    b.year_month,
    b.booked_slots,
    c.weekly_slots * d.days_in_month / 7.0 as capacity_slots,
    b.booked_slots / (c.weekly_slots * d.days_in_month / 7.0) as fill_rate
from booked b
join days d on b.year_month = d.year_month
cross join cap c
order by b.year_month

### Welcome!

Welcome to the auto-generated documentation for your dbt project!

### Navigation

You can use the `Project` and `Database` navigation tabs on the left side of the window to explore the models
in your project.

#### Project Tab
The `Project` tab mirrors the directory structure of your dbt project. In this tab, you can see all of the
models defined in your dbt project, as well as models imported from dbt packages.

#### Database Tab
The `Database` tab also exposes your models, but in a format that looks more like a database explorer. This view
shows relations (tables and views) grouped into database schemas. Note that ephemeral models are _not_ shown
in this interface, as they do not exist in the database.

### Graph Exploration
You can click the blue icon on the bottom-right corner of the page to view the lineage graph of your models.

On model pages, you'll see the immediate parents and children of the model you're exploring. By clicking the `Expand`
button at the top-right of this lineage pane, you'll be able to see all of the models that are used to build,
or are built from, the model you're exploring.

Once expanded, you'll be able to use the `--select` and `--exclude` model selection syntax to filter the
models in the graph. For more information on model selection, check out the [dbt docs](https://docs.getdbt.com/docs/model-selection-syntax).

Note that you can also right-click on models to interactively filter and explore the graph.
